snippet.title: BIRDCAGE - HALCYON Trailer
snippet.description:
Shoot, slash and weave through bullets and enemies in this story-driven arcade shooter. The RADON Daughters have launched their ultimate weapon. Take control of the experimental gunship HALCYON and break out of the CAGE.

BIRDCAGE launches on PC Tuesday November 18th and consoles in 2026!

Wishlist now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158550/BIRDCAGE

A game by Giannis Milonogiannis & Barry Topping.
